name: echo-tag
description: Echo Tag — a 3-minute multiplayer browser tag game where your last 3 seconds of movement become a solid obstacle.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @echo-tag/shared && npm run build -w @echo-tag/server && npm run build -w @echo-tag/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run bench:sim
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run size && npm run check:browser
